name: model-routing
description: LLM apps: decide whether a request needs a small, mid or frontier model.

difficulty.instructions: How much reasoning does it take to do the task in `request` well?
criteria: Trivial: a one-step lookup, translation, rewrite or format conversion with an obvious answer.
Routine: several steps of standard work a competent professional does without much thought, such as writing one function, one query, one page or one summary.
Hard: open-ended diagnosis or design across several systems, subtle concurrency or security issues, or long-horizon planning with trade-offs.
